name: Steam Rat
blurb: Nests in grate clouds and bites the ankles of commuters.

name: Taxi Crab
blurb: A checker-shell crustacean that sideswipes crosswalks.

name: Neon Lynx
blurb: Times Square fur, pupils like open signs.

name: Turnstile Moth
blurb: Wings stamped with expired Metro cards.

name: Brownstone Beetle
blurb: Carapace of stoop brick. Sleeps under doormats.

name: Subway Salamander
blurb: Wet tile skin. Rides the third rail for warmth.

name: Hydrant Toad
blurb: Inflates until the cap pops. Street kids dare each other.

name: Scaffold Spider
blurb: Spins caution tape between poles.

name: Hotdog Hopper
blurb: Cart-born amphibian. Mustard glands.

name: Broadway Bat
blurb: Marquee fangs. Applauds itself.

name: Pigeon King
blurb: Crown of bagel crumbs. Rules the ledge.

name: Manhole Mole
blurb: Pushes lids like coins. Collects lost rings.

name: Fire Escape Fox
blurb: Orange as rust. Climbs zigzags in the rain.

name: Dumpster Drake
blurb: A small dragon of yesterday's pizza.

name: L-Train Lizard
blurb: Striped like the line. Late, always.

name: Bagel Beetle
blurb: Sesame armor. Rolls if startled.

name: Pretzel Python
blurb: Salt-scaled coil from a cart that vanished.

name: Crosswalk Crane
blurb: Stands in the stripes and judges both sides.

name: Stoop Snail
blurb: Brownstone shell. Gossip is its mucus.

name: Alley Catfish
blurb: Whiskers full of takeout. Breathes puddles.

name: Newsstand Newt
blurb: Reads headlines with its throat.

name: Chimney Chimp
blurb: Soot hands. Steals antennas.

name: Gutter Gecko
blurb: Translucent. Maps the block by drip.

name: Meter Mantis
blurb: Arms like expired tickets.

name: Ferry Finch
blurb: Salt in the feathers. Commutes for fun.

name: Skyline Sloth
blurb: Hangs from water-tower legs. Sees Tuesday coming.

name: Cobble Cobra
blurb: Hood of wet street stone.

name: Radiator Rabbit
blurb: Hisses when the heat knocks.

name: Ironwork Ibis
blurb: Beak like a fire escape curl.

name: Deli Dingo
blurb: Mustard on the muzzle. Guards the pickle barrel.

name: Rooftop Raccoon
blurb: Mask of soot. Negotiates with pigeons.

name: Bridge Barnacle
blurb: Clings under the span. Counts trucks.

name: Siren Cicada
blurb: Sings in cop-car keys.

name: Foghorn Frog
blurb: Harbor throat. Wakes the piers.

name: Park Bench Badger
blurb: Claims the slats at dawn.

name: Water Tower Wasp
blurb: Nests in the cedar tank.

name: Graffiti Griffin
blurb: Wings of wet paint. Tags the sky.

name: Yellowline Yabbie
blurb: Crawls the painted curb like a riverbed.

name: Corner Deli Crow
blurb: Orders for a crowd that is only itself.

name: Steam Grate Grub
blurb: Fat with winter heat.

name: Highline Hedgehog
blurb: Quills of wildflower stems.

name: Bowery Boar
blurb: Tusks wrapped in concert flyers.

name: Canal Carp
blurb: Gowanus gold. Should not exist. Does.

name: Clocktower Crow
blurb: Nests in the hour. Late for nothing.

name: Harbor Herringhound
blurb: A dog that decided to be a fish on Tuesdays.

name: Brickbat Batlet
blurb: Small. Mean. Thrown, not flown, according to legend.

name: Umbrella Urchin
blurb: Spines that bloom when it rains.

name: Nightshift Numbat
blurb: Eats receipts. Works the graveyard.

name: Ashcan Axolotl
blurb: Smile of a thing that outlived the alley.

name: Borough Basilisk
blurb: Looks at a block and the block looks away.
